title: roadmap-state/3
description: The generated state of the roadmap (roadmap/state.json), written by `fy roadmap build` (tools/roadmap; CONVENTIONS section 4 for the banner, docs/briefs/architecture/roadmap-brief1.md for the rules). Deterministic: sorted keys and ids, repo-relative paths, no timestamps. `status` is derived on every build and never authored. Leaf statuses: done, blocked, active, ready. Stub statuses: blocked, expandable. Interior statuses: done, blocked, in_progress, not_started. `superseded` nodes are excluded from every count and from the frontier. `unknown` appears only when a status cannot be derived because the graph has errors (the server may return such a state; `fy roadmap build` writes nothing on errors). `stale` is reserved and never emitted. `counts` covers non-superseded nodes only. Version 2 (roadmap brief 2, T2) splits the old evaluation result `unknown`: `awaiting` is evidence that does not exist yet but could (no warning); `unknown` is evidence that cannot be read or expected (warns `criterion-unknown`). Neither is a pass. Version 3 (roadmap brief 3, T1 and T2) adds the node's `short` label and the top-level `tag_vocabulary`.

frontier.description: Every ready leaf and every expandable stub, sorted by id.

tag_vocabulary.description: roadmap/tags.yaml as {namespace: {value: colour or null}}; empty when the file is absent or unusable.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the node file.

dependents.description: Nodes whose effective blockers include this one.

short.description: The node's optional short label; null when it has none.
